CHAMELEONBAR — SETUP AND TROUBLESHOOTING
========================================

NORMAL SETUP
------------
1. Keep ChameleonBar.exe and ChameleonBar.XamlBridge.dll together in one
   folder.
2. If Windows 11 Taskbar Styler is enabled in Windhawk, disable it. Also
   disable the old ChameleonBar Tray Contrast Windhawk companion if you
   installed it. Only one tool should restyle the taskbar background.
3. Open ChameleonBar.exe.
4. The status card at the bottom-left of the window should say "Live".
5. Close the window. ChameleonBar keeps running in the notification area.
   Double-click its icon to open the window again.

No installation, administrator access or Windhawk runtime is required.

WHAT THE STATUS CARD MEANS
--------------------------
Live                 Everything is working.
Connecting           ChameleonBar is loading its bridge into Explorer. This
                     can take up to a couple of minutes right after sign-in.
Needs attention      The bridge couldn't load. The card says why; see below.
Taskbar not          The bridge was loaded but Explorer stopped answering.
responding           Use General > Restart Explorer.
Can't reach the bar  The bridge is running but couldn't find the taskbar
                     background. Use General > Restart Explorer once.
Paused               You paused color matching. The taskbar is back to the
                     Windows default.

IF THE BRIDGE CAN'T LOAD
------------------------
1. Make sure ChameleonBar.XamlBridge.dll is next to ChameleonBar.exe.
2. Turn off any other taskbar styler (Windhawk mods, TranslucentTB, etc.).
3. Open the window, go to General, and click "Restart Explorer". ChameleonBar
   reconnects automatically afterwards. (Signing out and back in also works.)
4. If you just updated ChameleonBar and the card mentions an older bridge,
   Restart Explorer once — the old version is still loaded in Explorer.
5. The [diagnostics] section of %LocalAppData%\ChameleonBar\settings.ini
   records the last bridge_status and bridge_message. 0x00000000 is success.

IF THE COLOR DISAPPEARS WHEN YOU OPEN START OR QUICK SETTINGS
-------------------------------------------------------------
This was fixed in 1.0. If you still see it, the old bridge from an earlier
preview is probably still loaded: use General > Restart Explorer once.

Note that with "Clear taskbar on an empty desktop" turned on (Look page), the
taskbar is intentionally see-through whenever no app window is open on that
monitor — for example after you minimize the last window. Turn it off if you
always want color.

IF TRAY TEXT OR ICONS HAVE THE WRONG COLOR
------------------------------------------
1. Open the Contrast page and make sure "Adaptive icon contrast" is on.
2. Raise "Switch to light glyphs below" if dark backgrounds still get dark
   icons. Lower "Switch back to dark glyphs above" if light backgrounds keep
   white icons too long. The second value always stays above the first.

IF TEXT, ICONS OR THIN LINES TINT THE TASKBAR
---------------------------------------------
1. Open the Sampling page and keep "Background colors only" on.
2. Raise "Ignore details up to" if a wide icon or label still shows up as a
   stripe. Lower it if you want small colored areas reproduced.

Every visible app window's edges are hard boundaries, so a large value can't
spread one window's color into its neighbour.

IF THE COLOR LAGS OR USES TOO MUCH CPU
--------------------------------------
- For faster response: Seamless or Vivid preset, or Sampling > Update rate
  at 16-33 ms.
- For less CPU: Battery saver preset, or raise Update rate and Segment width.
- For video: Cinema preset, or raise Look > Transition time.

RECOVERY AND UNDO
-----------------
- Right-click the tray icon and choose "Exit and restore taskbar".
- If ChameleonBar is force-closed or crashes, the bridge notices immediately
  and restores the native taskbar on its own.
- General > Reset everything returns all settings to their defaults.
- No system files are changed. If Explorer misbehaves for any reason,
  restarting Explorer or signing out restores everything.

PRIVACY
-------
Screen sampling is local and memory-only. ChameleonBar has no networking code,
analytics or telemetry, and never stores screenshots.
